// Objects  1 and 2 are where the two teams start; A, B and C are the capture points;
//          b  snowy firs (walkable, hide you from enemies more than 2 tiles away)
//          t s d o r c  station furniture: table, shelf, bunk (two cells), stove, fuel drum, supply crate —
//                       each blocks walking and bullets like a crate
